title: Digi AnywhereUSB Plus honored as Silver winner in the 11th Annual 2019 Golden Bridge Awards
summary: Digi AnywhereUSB recognized as Best New Product, Service or Solution of the Year. Digi and other winners will be honored at the 2019 Red Carpet Golden Bridge Awards Ceremony.
